label_justification: The submitted edit, a layer-23 down_proj change (REFR: W7 minus 8*u_close*b_wall), scored 0.466 on MATH-500, which is above the 0.29 threshold. Later paired generation passes on fresh problems (calls 322 to 353) gave the edited model about 0.51 to 0.62 against about 0.10 to 0.14 for the original. Loop evidence is present from call 8, which computed repeated 8-gram onset positions on token-limit generations. A locus tied to looping appears around calls 36 to 40 and 59, which compare loop-state and early-state positions at layers 22 and 23, including MLP gate activations and exit-token logit. Success depends only on the score, so the label does not change.
